The Digital Invitation Atelier

One Platform. Every Celebration. Complete Guest Management.

INVITE STUDIO is a digital invitation and guest-management platform that helps individuals, families and event hosts create personalized invitations, organize their guest lists, manage relationships and track guest responses — all from one convenient dashboard.

You no longer need to scramble across scattered spreadsheets, disconnected messaging apps, and forgotten paper slips. Everything you need is centralized in a single, refined workspace.

Digital Invitations

Create beautiful, personalized digital invitations for your celebrations. Each guest receives an unguessable invitation link greeting them with their own name.

Universal Luxury Layout

Guest Management

Save, organize, update and reuse your guest list for multiple events. Build your permanent address book once and avoid re-entering contacts year after year.

Excel Import & Address Book

Relationship Management

Organize guests by their relationship with the host, such as family, relatives, friends, colleagues and other groups. Make guest organization structured and effortless.

Family • Friends • Relatives

RSVP Management

Allow guests to respond through their personal invitation link. View overall aggregate attendance responses from your host dashboard without invasive cross-guest tracking.

Effortless Workflow

Your Celebration, Simplified in 6 Steps.

We eliminated the chaos of lost spreadsheets and repeated texting so you can focus on hosting.

01Step 1

Create Your Account

Sign up securely in seconds using your mobile number or email with instant 5-digit OTP verification.

02Step 2

Build Your Guest List

Add guests manually or import your entire contact list from Excel into your permanent My Guests address book.

03Step 3

Organize Guest Relationships

Categorize contacts by meaningful groups such as Family, Relatives, Friends, and Colleagues for targeted events.

04Step 4

Create Your Event

Specify occasion, event date, start time, venue address, dress code, and optional RSVP confirmation deadlines.

05Step 5

Generate Personalized Invitations

Our engine creates a unique, unguessable invitation link for each guest displaying their personal name.

06Step 6

Share & Track RSVP

Send via WhatsApp click-to-chat. Guests respond with 1 tap; view your live aggregate headcount from the dashboard.

Manage Every Event From One Dashboard.

Indian weddings frequently involve separate ceremonies — Mehendi, Sangeet, Wedding, and Reception. Create dedicated event cards for each function with unique dates and venues.

A Personal Touch for Every Guest

Not Just a Link. A Personal Invitation.

Generic broadcast links feel impersonal. INVITE STUDIO generates an individual, bespoke digital invitation URL for every guest on your list. When they click, they see an invitation addressed specifically to them.

Universal Luxury Design: Heirloom-quality typography, gilded borders, and responsive design tailored for smartphones.
Personalized Guest Names: Displays your guest's title and family name directly on the card header.
Unique Unguessable Links: Cryptographically generated invite tokens prevent unauthorized access.
No App Download Required: Runs seamlessly on iOS Safari, Android Chrome, and all web browsers.
Direct Delivery

From Your Dashboard to Their WhatsApp.

Share personalized invitations with guests directly through WhatsApp, making it easy for everyone to receive and view their invitation.

WhatsApp Click-to-Chat Message

• Direct host-to-guest WhatsApp dispatchPre-filled & ready to send

Personalized Messages. Individual Links. Zero Spam.

INVITE STUDIO uses WhatsApp's direct click-to-chat API. When you tap send from your dashboard, WhatsApp opens directly with your guest's number and their custom invitation message pre-loaded.

Personalized WhatsApp Messages

Each message automatically embeds the guest's personal name, event title, date, time, and venue.

English & Hindi Message Options

Native support for both English and traditional Hindi invitation messaging templates.

Direct Click-to-Chat Dispatch

Messages are sent directly from your own WhatsApp. We do not use third-party spam bots or unauthorized bulk delivery.

Catering & Headcount Accuracy

Know Who's Joining Your Celebration.

Guests can open their personal invitation link and submit their attendance response without downloading an application.

Attending & Declined Responses

Guests tap Attending or Not Attending in a single click. Their response updates your host dashboard headcounts in real time.

Response Deadlines

Set RSVP confirmation deadlines before your event date to lock in catering plates, venue seating, and travel arrangements with confidence.

Strict Aggregate Privacy Protection

In accordance with INVITE STUDIO's strict privacy architecture, hosts receive total aggregate attendance counts, protecting guest privacy without intrusive individual surveillance.
